symptom: `describe layout Atlas_Core.Atlas_Default` printed `-- Forms$SidebarToggleButton (sidebarToggle3)  -- NOT re-executable: mxcli cannot author this widget`, so a copied layout lost Atlas's responsive sidebar toggle
cause: No MDL keyword or writer for Forms$SidebarToggleButton; modelsdk/gen bound its caption under the SDK name `Caption` (the key-audit ledger listed it) where Studio Pro stores `CaptionTemplate`; and the scroll container region's `ToggleMode` was neither described nor written, so every region came out `None`
insight: Writing the widget was not enough: the first real `mxcli docker check` of the copy reported CE0628 "For the sidebar toggle button to work, the outermost widget on the layout must be a scroll container with a region that can be toggled" because the region's ToggleMode (ShrinkContentInitiallyClosed on Atlas's sidebar) had been dropped all along — invisible until a toggle existed. A widget's correctness can live in a SIBLING's property; run mxbuild on a describe→exec copy, diffing its errors against an untouched copy of the fixture (PedApp has no theme, so ~1000 CE6083s are baseline noise). Compare the written key set to the Studio Pro document (test `TestCopyAtlasDefaultKeepsTheSidebarToggle`) — reverting the gen key override fails it with `Caption` vs `CaptionTemplate`. A widget keyword parsed as a bare IDENTIFIER is TypeIsGeneric and refused as MDL-WIDGET25, so a builder-owned widget needs a lexer token.
